name: [💎600M] Bubble Gum Simulator INFINITY
desc:
Welcome to Bubble Gum Simulator INFINITY! 🫧

🎃 Halloween is here in Bubble Gum Simulator Infinity!

🎃 Trick or Treat around the Nightmare Town!
🥚 3 New Halloween Themed Eggs!
🔮 7+ Hatchable Secret Pets!
🎁 Spooky Shop & Halloween Chest!
💎 Halloween Rebirths, a bit more difficult than Autumn!
🏆 Halloween Rebirth Leaderboard! Get Items Hourly & Daily!
⚙️ Massive QOL Updates!
⭐ New Bundle, Level Up Pack, & Exclusive Pets!

⭐ Updates every Friday at 2PM EST!

☁️ Blow Bubble Gum to increase its size and jump into the clouds. Discover islands and secrets in the sky!

🥚 Hatch rare pets and build a powerful pet team!

A game by Rumble Studios.
